channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Caller News Foundation (dailycallernewsfoundation.org)

item.title: Jack Smith Secretly Sought Nearly Two Years Of Kash Patel’s Phone Records, Subpoenas Show
item.description: Former special counsel Jack Smith sought nearly two years' worth of Federal Bureau of Investigation Director Kash Patel's phone records, new documents show.

item.title: Taliban Frees US Detainee Amid Trump Admin’s Pressure
item.description: The Taliban regime released an American prisoner on Tuesday, less than two weeks after the Trump administration designated the country as a sponsor of wrongful detention.

item.title: Mark Levin And Joe Kent Get In Fiery Clash Over Israel’s Influence On Trump In Iran War
item.description: Radio and Fox News host Mark Levin and former Director of the National Counterterrorism Center Joe Kent clashed in a fiery on-air exchange Monday night over Israel’s role in the Iran war.

item.title: Majority Of GOP Voters Believe Iran Was Not Imminent Threat, New Poll Finds
item.description: Most Republican voters believe Iran was not actually an imminent threat to the U.S., according to a Democracy Institute poll released Monday.

item.title: John Fetterman Blasts Democrats Over Response To College Freshman Allegedly Killed By Illegal Alien
item.description: Democratic Pennsylvania Sen. John Fetterman on Tuesday criticized his party over its response to an illegal immigrant allegedly killing female college freshman Sheridan Gorman.

item.title: Blue State Senator Admits Who Democrats ‘Care About Most’ In Resurfaced Video
item.description: Connecticut Democrat Sen. Chris Murphy openly admitted that the people his party cares about "the most" are illegal aliens, in an interview clip from 2024 that resurfaced this week.

item.title: Majority Of Republicans Say Israel Influences US Foreign Policy Too Much, Weeks Into Iran War
item.description: A bare majority of likely Republican voters say Israel has too much influence over U.S. foreign policy weeks into the Iran War, a poll shared with the Daily Caller News Foundation shows.

item.title: Obama-Era CIA Director Tells MS NOW He’ll Take Iran’s Word Over Trump’s
item.description: Former Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) Director John Brennan said Monday that he believes Iran more than President Donald Trump.

item.title: DHS Shutdown May Be Over Soon As Senate Races Toward Off Ramp
item.description: Following a breakthrough meeting between Senate Republicans and Donald Trump Monday night, a deal to fund most of the Department of Homeland Security may finally be in sight after a costly, prolonged government shutdown.

item.title: Boston Schools Made It Impossible To Fail Then Took Victory Lap When No One Failed
item.description: The city of Boston has been crowing over vastly improved graduation rates in it's schools, but officials have neglected to mention the district's recent changes banning teachers from giving failing grades.
